integrity: All finite face and acyclic-matching calculations are reproducible from the supplied standard-library-only verifier. The result is a proof for one fixed finite complex, not an extrapolation from sampled data.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite theorem only for the sixty-four-point quaternary three-cube, not a general categorical-product theorem; finite exhaustive acyclic-matching certificate requires Python execution and remains unaudited independently. The 405-sphere multiplicity was conjectured before this proof; publication priority is subject to unindexed work.
title: Integral Rips homotopy of the quaternary Hamming three-cube
